تمتعضون (form VIII)
# تَمْتَعِضُونَ (tamtaʕiḍūna) /tam.ta.ʕi.dˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# تُمْتَعَضُونَ (tumtaʕaḍūna) /tum.ta.ʕa.dˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
